root.label: Kimmerle Mining dug ore at Easy Peasy mine

events.label: Kimmerle Mining dug ore at Easy Peasy mine

slots.name: ore dug
slots.sentence: In 2018, the company dug up 30 tons of ore in search of uranium, which is used to fuel nuclear power plants, and vanadium, which is used to strengthen steel.

slots.name: operational status
slots.sentence: Soon after, the mine ceased operations because low uranium prices made it uneconomical.

slots.name: lawsuit status
slots.sentence: Then in 2021, Mr. Kimmerle became a plaintiff in a lawsuit over Mr. Biden’s restoration of the monument’s boundaries.
